pr_title: drivers: ethernet: nxp_enet: Handle -ENOTSUP for fixed-link in phy_co…
pr_body:
Modified nxp_enet_phy_configure to handle -ENOTSUP returned by the PHY driver, indicating a fixed-link setup. If -ENOTSUP is returned, a warning is logged, and PHY configuration is skipped without causing initialization to fail.

depends on [87238](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/87238)
Fixes [87237](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/87237)

issue_context.title: NXP_ENET driver initialization fails with fixed link phy_mii

review_comments: @decsny If I follow your approach, it would require always reading the link state, whereas in the current solution, `phy_get_link_state` is only invoked when `ret == -ENOTSUP`. This means adding unnecessary latency in most drivers, except for `phy_mii` with a fixed link. In most cases, this issue won't occur, so the current approach keeps overhead minimal.
okay, it's fine in this case I think anyways
